hero.title: Terminology Glossary

terms.description: Systems for optimizing production planning considering constraints and resources.
Series of standards by the American Society of Mechanical Engineers for engineering drawings and documentation. Widely used in North America and international projects.
Process of verifying user access rights to CADBase platform resources.
System for configuring data access rights, allowing different users various access levels.
Software module extending main application functionality.
Process of connecting and using CADBase programming interface in third-party applications and systems.
Set of methods and protocols for interaction between various software components and systems.
Process of creating and managing assemblies from individual components and parts.
Unique authentication key providing access to CADBase platform API.
Process of creating and managing information about a construction object throughout its lifecycle.
Method of representing 3D objects through their boundaries - faces, edges, and vertices.
Technologies and methods for analyzing business data to support management decisions.
Complete list of components, assemblies and materials with their quantities for manufacturing a product.
Systematic approach methodology to managing and improving enterprise business processes.
Mathematical curve used in computer graphics and CAD for representing complex shapes. Main advantage is local control: changing one control point affects only a limited section of the curve.
Sequence of steps and operations for completing specific business task.
Parametric curve used in computer graphics for modeling smooth shapes.
Process of comparing product characteristics, processes or methods with best market analogues.
Formalized constraints and conditions defining behavior of business processes and systems.
System for quick access to frequently used components and projects in CADBase platform.
Approved version of product configuration serving as basis for subsequent changes.
Surface where layer-by-layer object construction occurs in 3D printer.
3D printing technology where liquid binder is deposited on thin powder layer, bonding particles together to form object.
Use of computer software for engineering analysis including strength calculations, thermal and dynamic analyses.
Concept of integrated information support for products throughout their lifecycle.
Use of computer systems for developing manufacturing process plans for parts.
CAE field dealing with computer modeling of fluid and gas flows using numerical methods for analyzing hydrodynamic, thermal and mass transfer processes.
Use of computer systems for planning, managing and controlling manufacturing operations.
Process of collective product development involving various departments and partners.
System for managing interactions with customers and enterprise partners.
Process of determining production capacities needed to fulfill production plans.
Solid modeling method using boolean operations on primitives.
System for managing after-sales service and customer support.
3D printing technology from Carbon using continuous photopolymerization process with oxygen inhibiting layer for significant print speed increase.
Thematic collection of components organized by specific criteria for convenient search and navigation.
Main structural unit of CADBase platform containing all information about product, material or equipment.
Process of systematizing objects by certain features and categories.
Network architecture where clients request services from centralized servers.
Approach to managing all product information in distributed development environment.
Process of placing new or modified object in electronic storage with replacement of previous object version.
System-controlled process of extracting product database components for viewing, reference or use in other projects.
Software tool for creating custom product configurations based on modular approach.
Remote data storage on CADBase servers providing file access from any device and secure backup.
CADBase infrastructure providing storage, management and project collaboration services via internet.
Process of transferring design data between different CAD systems.
Methodology of parallel product development where various design stages are performed simultaneously.
Coordinates and orientation of cutting tool in CAM systems for forming CNC toolpaths.
Centralized storage acting as 'source of truth' for projects.
Software for creating 3D models, drawings and design documentation.
Normative document developed and applied within specific enterprise for process and product unification.
Ability of various systems and components to work together and exchange data.
Process of managing changes in product configuration throughout entire lifecycle.
Equipment control system based on numerical commands generated by computer.
Platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in containers, providing software isolation and portability.
Autodesk file format for secure publishing and distribution of design data without transferring source project files.
File format for storing 2D and 3D design data. Originally created for AutoCAD but became industry standard supported by many CAD systems.
Open Autodesk file format for data exchange between different CAD systems. Ensures compatibility when transferring 2D geometry and annotations between different software platforms.
3D printing technology similar to SLA but using digital projector to cure entire layer of photopolymer resin simultaneously.
Metal 3D printing technology where laser sinters metal powder layer by layer to create dense metal parts.
Process of moving information between different systems and applications.
User or system using data to perform their functions.
Creative process of developing concepts, solutions and documentation for creating new products.
Specialist creating and modifying data in system.
Specialist checking and approving data before their use in production.
Three-dimensional digital product model used for analysis and simulation before physical production.
Process of integrating digital technologies into all business aspects, fundamentally changing ways of working and value creation.
Software for managing electronic documents and their business processing workflows.
System for managing enterprise fixed assets and equipment throughout their lifecycle.
Software for designing electronic circuits and printed circuit boards.
Integrated system for managing main business processes in real-time.
System for managing computer modeling and simulation processes in enterprise.
Metal 3D printing technology in vacuum chamber using electron beam to melt metal powder, suitable for refractory metals.
Complex of state standards establishing uniform rules and norms for execution, formatting and handling of design documentation in Russian Federation.
Completed product ready for use or sale.
Part of design related to developing specific structures, assemblies and part designs.
Concept including main enterprise and its partners, suppliers and customers in unified business environment.
State change in system that can initiate certain actions or processes.
Formalized process for managing changes in product design or documentation.
Intranet extension for external users.
Native FreeCAD file format containing 3D models, construction history and design parameters.
CAE field using finite element method for computer modeling and analysis of physical processes: strength calculations, thermal, dynamic and other types of engineering analysis.
Numerical method for solving differential equations widely used for engineering calculations of strength, heat transfer, dynamics and other physical processes.
Numerical method for solving differential equations based on replacing derivatives with difference relations on discrete grid.
Numerical method for solving partial differential equations based on integrating equations over control volumes.
3D printing technology where plastic filament is fed through heated extruder and deposited layer by layer on build platform.
System reliability analysis method using tree diagrams to identify and evaluate failure causes and potential failure points.
Logical diagram showing relationships between cause events and system failure event.
Information systems architecture combining heterogeneous systems into unified environment.
Discrete geometry representation as set of finite elements used for numerical solution of equations by finite element method.
Separate geometric element of model having specific functional purpose.
Logical group of files organized by software types or purpose within component modification.
License permitting free use, modification and distribution of software.
Material in filament form used in FDM 3D printers.
Process of adding geometric tolerances and technical requirements directly to 3D model in CAD.
Strategic financial planning and analysis aimed at optimizing operational activities, cost management and growth stimulation in manufacturing industry.
Strongly typed application programming interface allowing clients to request exactly the data they need in predictable format.
User interface using graphical elements for interacting with software.
Commands for controlling computer numerical control machines.
Methodology for classifying parts by design and technological features to optimize production.
System of symbols and standards for defining geometric characteristics of parts.
Chinese national standards including sections on technical drawing and design documentation.
Graphical representation of project schedule showing tasks, deadlines and dependencies.
Software module solving system of geometric equations and constraints in CAD systems.
Basic software component of CAD system responsible for mathematical operations with geometry.
System for managing enterprise personnel including hiring, training and employee development.
An open, neutral file format for exchanging Building Information Modeling (BIM) data between different software applications. Developed and maintained by buildingSMART International.
Files with .frag extension containing partial or fragmented IFC model data. Used for incremental updates, extracting data subsets, or exchanging only changed parts of BIM models.
File format for CAD data exchange between different systems.
International standard establishing general principles for technical drawings presentation.
Property of parts or assemblies allowing their replacement without additional processing or fitting.
Unique code assigned to each element in system for its identification.
Internal private enterprise network using internet technologies.
Individual component occurrence in assembly that can have unique positional parameters.
Open standard for creating access tokens based on JSON format.
Siemens company file format for lightweight 3D visualization and collaboration.
Open-source container orchestration system for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.
Methodology using knowledge bases to automate engineering processes and decision making.
3D printing technology where material sheets are layered, bonded and cut by laser or cutting tool.
Structured collection of components organized by categories, tags or other criteria.
Sequence of product existence stages from concept to disposal.
Folder on user computer where downloaded components and files are stored for offline work.
Method of adding objects from external file to scene without direct data copying.
Indicator of current component lifecycle stage in system.
Documents containing detailed instructions for manufacturing operations, including equipment setup, processing parameters, quality control, and safety procedures.
Software for designing mechanical parts and assemblies.
Information system for managing and monitoring production processes in real-time.
System for managing technological processes and production resources.
System for planning purchases and production based on specifications and production plans.
Plan for finished goods production over specific time period.
3D printing technology using array of print heads for high-speed deposition of photopolymer materials with wax or other soluble support material.
Group of metal 3D printing technologies including direct metal laser sintering, selective laser melting and electron beam melting.
Specific component version with design documentation, specifications and related documents.
Information about data: author, version, creation date, status and other file attributes.
Process of creating digital representations of objects in three-dimensional space.
Technological process of changing workpiece shape, dimensions and surface quality by removing material with cutting tool.
Unique identifier of finished product in manufacturer catalog.
Function of importing selected file or component into current document for further work.
Specialized CAD section for designing injection molds, dies and press forms.
3D printing technology where photopolymer materials are deposited through microscopic nozzles and immediately cured by UV light.
Mathematical model for representing curves and surfaces in computer graphics.
3D models and technical documentation provided by equipment manufacturers for use in projects.
Company manufacturing components or products used in final products of other manufacturers.
Software whose source code is available for study, modification and distribution.
Document containing a detailed description of the technological process for manufacturing a part or assembling a unit, including operations, equipment, tools, tooling, and time standards.
Systems for automating data and document storage, managing product structure and work processes.
Systems for managing information and processes at each stage of product lifecycle - from design to disposal.
Data about tolerances, dimensions, surface finish and other manufacturing requirements in 3D models.
3D printing technology from Stratasys using print heads to deposit liquid photopolymers with subsequent UV curing.
Three-dimensional object representation as set of polygons.
Reference part version in system containing all approved data and specifications.
Characteristic or property of component containing additional information.
Capability to search components by their technical characteristics, materials, dimensions and other attributes.
Design method where geometry is defined by parameters and dependencies between them.
Creating 3D models using polygons to represent surfaces.
Liquid material used in SLA and DLP 3D printers that cures under ultraviolet light exposure.
Advanced open-source object-relational database management system supporting complex queries and transactions.
Set of organizational structure, procedures, processes and resources for product quality management.
Automation system functionality for automatic document generation based on project data.
Part that can be used instead of original without degrading product characteristics.
Process of evaluating and approving data, documents or projects by authorized persons.
Set of user rights and responsibilities in system defining their access to data and functions.
Amazon Web Services object storage service providing scalable, highly available, and secure data storage.
Systems for end-to-end supply chain management, simplifying logistics and procurement optimization.
Cryptographic hash function used for file integrity verification and computing unique identifiers.

synonyms: STandard for the Exchange of Product data
terms.description: International standard for exchanging product data between different CAD/CAM/CAE systems.
Business intelligence platforms allowing end users to independently create reports and analyze data without IT assistance.
3D printing file format representing object surface as triangles.
3D printing technology using ultraviolet laser to cure liquid photopolymer resin layer by layer into solid plastic.
3D printing technology where laser sinters powder materials into solid objects layer by layer.
Metal 3D printing technology where laser completely melts metal powder, creating parts with mechanical properties close to cast ones.
Concept where all project participants work with same current data from single source.
Creating 3D models using mathematical surfaces for precise modeling of complex shapes.
Procedure for checking design and technological documentation compliance with established standards, norms and rules.
Creating 3D models representing objects as solid bodies with defined volume.
Temporary structures generated by software and printed with main model to support overhangs, bridges and complex geometries.
Modeling method where coarse mesh is sequentially subdivided to create smooth surfaces.
Specialized CAD section for designing sheet metal parts and stamping tooling.
Technology for creating 3D models by 'sculpting' virtual surface.
Main design document defining composition of assembly unit, kit or complex.
Property of numerical method to approach exact solution with increasing number of mesh elements/nodes.
Financial planning method considering various development scenarios to optimize management decisions.
Process of coordinating data between local storage and CADBase cloud platform.
Normative document establishing uniform technical requirements, rules, characteristics and procedures.
Architectural style where applications consist of independent services interacting over network.
Mathematical curve defined by set of control points and interpolation functions.
3D printing technology using photopolymerization of liquid resin under laser action.
Indicator characterizing speed of new product development and market launch.
Commands in CNC control programs for selecting, changing or identifying cutting tools.
Platform functionality allowing multiple users to work on single project simultaneously with version control and permission management.
3D model represented as set of triangles or other polygons.
Document establishing technical requirements for products, materials or processes.
Keyword or label for categorizing and searching components.
Set of methods, processes and materials for manufacturing products.
Complex of fixtures, tools and equipment used in production process.
Process of representing surface or object as set of triangles.
Condition or event that automatically launches specific process or action in system.
System for checking and ensuring compliance of technological processes, operations and equipment with established requirements.
Identification standard used in programming to create unique object identifiers.
Standard file format for embedding 3D graphics in PDF documents.
Programming language for creating interactive 3D worlds and objects.
File change management system allowing tracking change history, creating new versions and reverting to previous file states.
Design method where parameter changes automatically update model geometry.
Situation where user depends on specific software vendor and cannot easily switch to alternative solutions.
Specialized interface in FreeCAD containing tools for specific tasks.
Initial material form intended for further mechanical processing or part manufacturing.
Three-dimensional object representation as lines and vertices without surfaces.
Group of specialists working together on product or project development.
Universal markup language for storing and transmitting structured data.
Text file format of Parasolid geometric modeling kernel.
Data compression and file archiving format often used for packaging CAD data.
Tool for viewing and interacting with 3D models directly in browser without additional software installation.
Technology of layer-by-layer creation of physical objects based on digital 3D models.
Software for creating and editing three-dimensional graphics.

Documents in the Russian documentation system (ESKD) containing instructions for technological preparation of production, processing, assembly, and product control. Defines operation sequence, equipment, tools, and processing parameters.
